description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Front Bumper, Both Front Bumper End Caps and Front Blinkers
Front Bumper is pre-painted black
Includes Bumper End Caps
Includes Front Turn Lights
Turn Key Install
Direct Replacement
NOTE: This bumper is formed via a stamped metal process and has surface imperfections that are typical to this process. While acceptable for normal Samurais, if you are building a show vehicle this bumper may not meet your needs.
NOTE: These are new caps with minor imperfections from the molding process. The material is rigid and fitment may be off.
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Front Bumper (OEM)
Qty 1 – LH Protector Cap (After-Market)
Qty 1 – RH Protector Cap (After-Market)
Qty 1 – LH Blinker Light (After-Market)
Qty 1 – RH Blinker Light (After-Market)
What Vehicles Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984
